title: Real-time V.A.T.S.
description: V.A.T.S. runs in real time as in Fallout 76; Luck decides how fast the critical meter fills.

settings.description: The critical charge curve. A later plugin's curve replaces the earlier one as a whole.

luck_critical_charge_curve.description: Critical charge added per hit for each Luck value (x = Luck, y = charge). x must increase.
luck_critical_charge_curve.title: Critical charge by Luck

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the curve was read from. Generated by BACUP from the Fallout 76 data; you normally leave it alone.

settings.title: Settings

x-help:
With real-time V.A.T.S. on, a tap of the V.A.T.S. button locks on to a target and your shots are steered at the chosen body part. Hits fill a critical meter; the curve below says how much each hit adds for each Luck level.

In the curve, x is the player's Luck and y is the critical charge added per hit. Luck outside the points uses the nearest end point.
